content.title: Thunder vs Celtics highlights: SGA breaks an NBA scoring record in OKC win over Boston
content.text: March 12, 2026Updated March 13, 2026, 12:27 a.m. CTShai Gilgeous-Alexander and the OKC Thunder will host Jaylen Brown and the Boston Celtics at 8:30 p.m. CT Thursday.OKC (51-15) outlasted the Denver Nuggets for a 129-126 home win on Monday. Boston (43-22) fell short in a 125-116 road loss to the San Antonio Spurs on Tuesday.Gilgeous-Alexander will look to make history. He's tied with Wilt Chamberlain for the all-time longest streak of 20-point performances (126 games).Follow along for live updates throughout tonight's Thunder-Celtics game:Order new book on Thunder's run to NBA titleThunder vs Celtics score updates[ LISTEN UP: Make the "Thunder Buddies" podcast a staple of your starting lineup by following onApple,Spotify andYouTube. ]Final: Thunder 104, Celtics 102 | OKC tops Boston on last-second free throws from Chet HolmgrenShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 35 points and 9 assistsChet Holmgren: 14 points and 9 boardsAjay Mitchell: 15 points and 6 assistsPayton Pritchard's buzzer-beating 3-pointer is no good, and OKC improves to 52-15 on a night when SGA sets the record for the most consecutive 20-point games in NBA history.End of the third quarter: Celtics 83, Thunder 80 | SGA breaks record, but Boston leadsShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 21 points and 8 assistsChet Holmgren: 12 points and 5 reboundsAjay Mitchell: 10 points and 6 assistsThe night has been about SGA, but Boston has been impressive. Jaylen Brown is leading the way with 23 points and 7 assists. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander breaks NBA record for longest streak of scoring at least 20 points in a gameThere it is. OKC’s Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has surpassed Wilt Chamberlain for the longest streak of 20-point games in NBA history (127). A record that has gone untouched since 1963 now belongs to SGA.Halftime: Celtics 59, Thunder 56 | Shai Gilgeous-Alexander closing on Wilt Chamberlain's NBA recordShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 17 points and 4 assistsChet Holmgren: 10 points and 4 reboundsAaron Wiggins: 7 points and 3 reboundsSGA is three points away from breaking Wilt Chamberlain's record for consecutive 20-point games (126).End of the first quarter: Celtics 28, Thunder 27 | Shai Gilgeous-Alexander halfway to 20 pointsShai Gilgeous-Alexander: 10 points and 2 assistsChet Holmgren: 7 points and 3 reboundsAjay Mitchell: 4 points and 1 reboundJaylen Brown leads Boston with 8 points and 3 assists. The Celtics are winning the TO battle, 5-2. What time is Thunder vs Celtics game tonight?Date: Thursday, March 12Time: 8:30 p.m. CTWhere: Paycom Center in Oklahoma CityWatch Thunder vs Celtics live on FuboWhat channel is OKC Thunder vs Boston Celtics on tonight?TV: FanDuel Sports NetworkStreaming: Prime Video (how to watch)How to watch online: Fubo (free trial)Thunder vs Celtics predictions, picksJustin Martinez: OKC 122, Boston 115Shai Gilgeous-Alexander arguably delivered the best regular-season performance of his career during a win over Denver, and Ajay Mitchell looked as sharp as ever despite missing 20 straight games. Now, the Thunder is getting back two elite defenders in Chet Holmgren and Alex Caruso. OKC is picking up some serious momentum, and I expect it to keep rolling on Thursday with a home win over a Boston team that has Jayson Tatum and Derrick White listed as questionable.Thunder vs Celtics betting oddsOdds via BetMGM as of Thursday, March 12Odds: Thunder by 7.5Over/under: 216.5Moneyline: OKC -300 | Boston +240Thunder vs Celtics injury updatesThunder: Branden Carlson (low back strain) is out. Isaiah Hartenstein (left calf contusion) is out. Thomas Sorber (right ACL surgical recovery) is out. Nikola Topić (G League assignment) is out. Jalen Williams (right hamstring strain) is out.Celtics: Jayson Tatum (right Achilles injury management) is out. John Tonje (G League two-way) is out. Nikola Vucevic (right ring finger fracture) is out.
